links.outcome: Clinical correctness of LLM responses in English versus Hausa, by model tier
links.effect: Locally deployable models' mean clinical correctness fell from 1.57 in English to -0.03 in Hausa; the frontier model moved from 2.00 to 1.75 with no harmful responses in either language.
links.quote: Among locally deployable models, mean clinical correctness fell from 1.57 in English to -0.03 in Hausa, on a scale where 2 denotes a correct answer and -1 an actively harmful one.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation comparing clinical safety and correctness of small deployable LLMs versus a frontier LLM across English and Hausa medical prompts.
